issue.title: Lesson enforcer list is generated automatically and covers every registry incident
issue.body: Zenoforge issue #1049: Make the generated lesson-enforcer index cover every incident in the incident-guard registry. Each incident should be listed as enforced or named as lacking an enforcer, and a check should fail when the generated file is stale. Keep the docs and focused-test mapping aligned.

issue.title: Enforce the issue-loop / unit-loop merge boundary with a source check
issue.body: Zenoforge issue #1050: Enforce the boundary that the issue loop does not own the merge queue. Keep the existing hand-owned factory-PR merge as one named exception, make a source check reject other direct PR-merge calls, and describe the enforced rule in the architecture and enforcement docs.

issue.title: Ratchet for shortcut comments: the count may shrink, not grow
issue.body: Zenoforge issue #1051: Add a per-file ratchet for deliberate shortcut markers in non-test engine and tools code. Counts may shrink but cannot grow unless the baseline is explicitly raised. Refusals should name the file and both corrective options; add the test and enforcement row.

issue.title: eval: start stage-call codex with plugins off
issue.body: Zenoforge issue #1037: Make every Codex launch in the eval stage call pass the shared plugins-off arguments, so stage runs do not download the plugin catalog. Follow the engine's existing launch pattern and keep its static launch check green.

issue.title: Review reads the verification evidence for the head it reviews
issue.body: Zenoforge issue #1047: Carry the reviewed head's verification result into the review prompt. State the command and exit code, include bounded evidence for a pass, and name RED or skipped explicitly. A finding only a test can prove stays unverified with its rerun command and evidence, and cannot pass READY. Update the related engine docs and checks.
